page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Two engraved medallions side by side, left with the legend around Charles V, right with the legend around Isabella. Below them one column of running text, full width, with paragraphs. Signature at bottom right. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.l: IMP. CAES. CAROLVS V AV
ISABELLA CAR. V[?]
CAROLVS quintus, Philippi Austriæ Archiducis filius,
post auum Maximilianum imperat anno mundi 5481. à Chri-
sto nato 1519. postea Bononiæ à Clemente Pontifice imperiali
diademate coronatus est anno D. 1529. porrò anno sequente
ingentem exercitum per Germaniam in Hügariā duxit aduer-
sus Turcam Viennā obsidentē. Inde victoriam reportans in Hi-
spaniam rediit. Anno autem 1535. in Tunetim expeditionē pa-
rans, quæ olim Carthago erat, eam Solimano Turcæ extorquet:
Gouletā arcē expugnat: regnūque Tunitiū totū recipit, &c Regē
Altzachenū antè pulsū restituit, multis Christianis captiuis libe-
ratis. Frācia bis tētauit, sed Frāci milites validissimis armis eius
impetū forti animo sustinuere. Semel in Francia tanquā amicus
summo apparatu exceptus est, ex Hispania in Flādriā per Galliā
iter sibi fecit. At enim an. 1543. cū potentissimo exercitu Ger-
maniā tandē ingressus, eam ferè totā in suā vertit sententiā, ca-
ptis etiā aliquot Germanorū Ducibus ac primoribus: à quibus
atq; ab vrbibus Germaniæ olim liberis, ingētē auri vim corrasit.
Anno verò 1551. in Africā Libyę ciuitatē exercitū traiecit, prin-
cipe Doria præfecto, quam feliciter expugnauit, solutis nō pau-
cis captiuis Christianis. An. 1552. Confœderatis aliquot Ger-
manorum Principibus cū Henrico Christianiss. Francorū Rege,
ea gratia vt eos ab Imperatoris iugo excuteret, pedem in Villa-
cū Carolus quasi coactus reculit: sed intra paucos dies re cū ali-
quot Germanis primoribus cōposita, cōparato maximo Germa-
norū exercitu, ipse Mediomatricū, vrbē prius ab Hērico Rege
captam, ac Francicis armis munitam obsedit: vbi nouercam
fortunam expertus, obsidionem soluere cogitur, cum non mo-
dica suorum strage ac damno, partim ob temporis inclemen-
tiam, partim ob Francorum robur ac vigilantiam.
ISABELLA Portugalliæ Regis filia, Caroli prędicti vxor
peperit ei liberos quatuor, atque in partu vltimo emoritur.

page.notes: Two engraved medallion legends are printed above the text; their letters are worn, so the legend on the right ("CAR. V") is uncertain and the left legend's exact letters may be incomplete. Reference "reculit" in the line "Villacū Carolus quasi coactus reculit" is doubtful. Printed spacing and run-ons such as "Hispaniain" and "Germaniā" are kept as the scan shows them. Printing errors kept as printed, e.g. "Tunetim", "Hispania in", "Tunitiū".
